label: Office II, Medizinische Physik, University of Oldenburg
note: Kayser et al. 2009: an office room on the natural science campus, T60 300 ms; the head-and-torso simulator on a chair behind a desk, looking straight ahead (towards the window) or turned 90 degrees (looking over the shoulder); loudspeakers at the entrance (door open), at two desks and at the window (window open); 3.30 x 6.00 m from the sketch, height not given. Measurement 7 of the SOFA file (window, head turned) repeats measurement 3 (window, head straight) sample for sample; its interaural cues are those of the head facing the window, so RIRDB leaves measurement 7 out. With the loudspeaker in the open doorway (A), rt_mid reads 0.42-0.45 s against 0.30-0.34 s for the other loudspeakers: the corridor behind the open door lengthens the decay. The file's ListenerView is turned 90 degrees from the sketch.
